executive_assessment.text: The NDC reports 11 tropical depressions or cyclones in 2018–2023; Cyclone Kenneth caused damage valued at 14% of GDP and affected over 345,000 people, including 12,000 displaced.
The communication says open-field farming with little vegetation is more erosion-prone than traditional mixed agroforestry with persistent soil cover.
The NDC organizes adaptation around water management, climate-resilient agriculture and food security, coastal and marine systems, infrastructure and habitat, and health.
